newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal cuts repo rate to 6.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal cuts repo rate to 6.7 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it was cutting its repurchase pact rate to 6.70 percent from 6.90 percent and its rate for draining funds to 6.20 percent from 6.40 percent.
The Bank cut its emergency lending rate to 8.30 percent from 8.50 percent.
The central bank offered to inject 170 billion escudos of seven-day funds at the start of a new accounting period for commercial bank cash reserves which starts tomorrow.
